mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance, reducing discount rates for equity valuation and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate below 3.5% indicates a tight labor market, boosting consumer confidence and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE < 3.5%, or the signal's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in GDP and housing starts signals robust consumer demand and economic expansion, driving corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction signal fails when either GDPC1 or HOUST is negative, or the Rank IC for the joint signal is below 0.02 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production indicates a supply-side slowdown, reducing corporate output and profits, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO declines, or the signal's Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Rising CPI inflation typically prompts central bank tightening, increasing real interest rates and reducing equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL rises, or the Rank IC for the signal is below 0.02 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Retail sales growth exceeding 0.5% month-over-month signals strong consumer spending, boosting corporate revenues and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when RSAFS > 0.5% MoM, or the signal's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent increases in payrolls and decreases in unemployment indicate a strengthening labor market, enhancing consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal fails when either PAYEMS declines or UNRATE rises, or the Rank IC for the interaction is below 0.02 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Rising industrial production signals expanding supply capacity and economic growth, driving corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days during supply expansion cycles.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO rises, or the signal's Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.
